  ym=((hh>=15)&(hh<=50)&(ss>90)&(vv>70)).mean()

  elif lm>.45: c='W'
  elif bm>.3: c='B'
  elif vv.mean()<70:c='d'
  elif vv.mean()>145:c='w'
  else:c='.'
  row+=c
 print(row)
